title: What are some of the books to recommend if you like the latest Perfect Days 2023 by Wim Wenders?

commenti.body: The Big Picture podcast just did a good interview with Wenders about the movie. He talks about the Japanese tendency to venerate craftsmen and to find the craft in your job. I'm not sure he mentions any books in particular but I found the discussion useful.

Not sure about books, but there's a great short story by Joy Williams called "The Yard Boy" that has this vibe in spades:


https://www.theparisreview.org/fiction/3515/the-yard-boy-joy-williams

I think you would love anything by yoko ogawa, but particularly "the housekeeper & the professor". It's really lovely and touching and all about this theme - it's a super heartwarming book that I really love
